title: Coulthart's changing sources on the drone flyovers
summary: Flying Lotus tells of Coulthart's changing sources on the drone flyovers, about 2024 at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: you know, I remember when those the Chinese drones were flying over and he was always like, "My sources say this and my sources say that and he's so confident about sources and then his sources keep changing the story still."

plain: A hip hop musician called Flying Lotus, talking on podcast host Jesse Michels' show in 2025, looks back at 2024, when drones he calls "the Chinese drones" were seen flying over the United States. He says a journalist, Ross Coulthart, kept talking very confidently about what his sources were telling him, but the sources kept changing the story. Flying Lotus tells it as a reason to be careful about who to trust when people claim inside knowledge.
